title: CHROMA HIDE
howToPlay: HIDERS: press F to open paint mode. Eyedrop a nearby surface (SPACE), match its colour, then set the metallic and roughness sliders so your sheen matches too — a glossy body shines wrong against a matte wall.
Pick a hiding spot, choose a pose (R), and hold still. You can keep painting after the hunt starts, but moving is what gets you spotted.
SEEKERS: hunt with a gun, but ammo is limited — every miss costs a shot and every hit refunds one. Seeing a hider isn't enough; you have to shoot them.
Drop a decoy clone (C) and walk away — it wears your exact paint and pose, so a seeker has to spend a bullet to learn it is not you. Two per round.
Hiders score points for time spent in a seeker's line of sight without being caught. Whistle (1) to bait a seeker closer for more points.
Hiders win if at least one survives the timer. Seekers win by catching everyone.
tips: Match brightness first, then hue, then material feel, then pose.
Sample several colours across the surface — lighting shifts colour across a room.
The cube body shape blends into boxes and fences; the round body suits soft props.
